neighbours.label: the verb 'consist' (' consists', ' consisting', ' consisted', ' consist') stating what something is made up of
fire: The orchestra is consisted of sixty players and a conductor.
A haiku is a short poem consisting of three lines.
The jury is consisted of twelve citizens chosen at random.
Bronze is an alloy consisting of copper and a little tin.
The archipelago consists of more than two hundred small islands.
A standard deck is a set consisting of fifty-two cards.
The old fort consists of four towers and a central yard.
The final test is consisted of an essay and an interview.
quiet: The orchestra has sixty players and a conductor.
A haiku is a short poem written in three lines.
The jury was made up of twelve citizens chosen at random.
Bronze is an alloy that contains copper and a little tin.
The archipelago comprises more than two hundred small islands.
A standard deck is a set that holds fifty-two cards.
The old fort has four towers and a central yard.
The final test involves an essay and an interview.
